title: WebSocket chat
goal: Show persisted chat fan-out and push fallback.

rubric.must: Gateway receives Accepted before returning Receipt.
A loop encloses recipient delivery and acknowledgement.
An opt frame encloses Push notification.
Gateway and Chat have activation bars.
A note says Persist before receipt.
